clusters.reason: The PR fixes lossy integer-to-float conversions near boundaries like 2^63 that caused distinct integers to compare equal to the same float.
The PR corrects strict weak ordering for mixed number comparisons so that nearby integers are properly ordered rather than colliding with the float.
Unsigned integers near the upper float bounds are now compared exactly instead of rounding up and falsely equating to the float.
Negative integer and float comparisons near boundaries are handled with exact precision rather than lossy widening.
The PR explicitly resolves the issue where equivalence was intransitive; the new behavior correctly maintains strict weak ordering.
Using distinct numbers that previously collapsed due to precision loss as map keys now correctly distinguishes them, increasing the map size.
Symmetric comparison operators with float on the left-hand side now correctly reflect exact comparisons instead of false equalities.
Relational operators between large integers and floats are updated to use exact comparison, changing old false equalities into correct less-than relations.
